THE STORY BEHIND THE GUIDE

A little more meaning
in every moment.

Wishly Guide is the learning and information space for people exploring personal wish websites. It explains the product, shares practical ideas and helps creators use the tools with confidence.

WHY THIS EXISTS

Technology should help people express what matters.

Some messages deserve more than a plain text. A birthday wish, a proposal, an apology or a shared memory can become a small digital experience with its own design, words and details.

Wishly was created around that idea: make it possible for people to build and share personal pages without having to learn web development first.

This guide exists to make the process easier to understand. It brings together product explanations, practical tutorials, design tips and answers to common questions.

RA

Built by RA Fahim

Wishly was created by web developer and solo founder RA Fahim, with the goal of making personal digital experiences easier for everyone to create and share.

About the founder ↗

WHAT WE BELIEVE

Personal first.
Technology second.

The best tools stay out of the way and make it easier for people to focus on the message they want to share.

01

Make it approachable

A person should not need to understand HTML, CSS or JavaScript to start with a thoughtful template and personalize it.

02

Leave room for individuality

Different people and occasions call for different colors, words, media and interactions. The result should feel personal.

03

Make sharing simple

A published page should be easy to open in a browser and straightforward to share with a link.

Discover what you can create.

Visit Wishly to explore the templates and make a page of your own.
